[NL-REW-07] Hartwell Netherlands pay bands, senior maintenance technicians and other technical roles, 2027
Pay bands (monthly salary scales) for technical roles at Hartwell Netherlands under the company collective agreement, from January 1, 2027. Pay group 6, Technicus (maintenance technician): 2,980 to 3,940 euros a month. Pay group 7, Technisch Specialist (senior maintenance technician): 3,412 to 4,689 euros a month. Pay group 8, Teamleider Technische Dienst: 3,890 to 5,320 euros a month. A holiday allowance of 8% is paid in May.

[DE-REW-02] Hartwell Germany pay groups (Entgeltgruppen) for technical roles, 2027
Monthly pay groups for Hartwell Germany technical roles from January 1, 2027. EG 6 Servicetechniker: 3,180 to 3,920 euros a month. EG 7 senior maintenance technician (Servicetechniker mit Schichtverantwortung): 3,560 to 4,310 euros a month.

[GRP-REC-01] Group recruitment standard, setting an offer
Every offer states a base salary inside the band for the role's own country and entity. A band from one entity is never used to set an offer in another. Questions about another country's pay go to the Group Head of Reward.

[NL-REW-08] Rotterdam pay group placements, technical staff, June 2027
Placements of Rotterdam technical staff in pay groups, June 2027. Pay group 7 (senior maintenance technician): Daan Verbeek, step 9, 4,402 euros a month; Sanne Kuipers, step 6, 4,012 euros a month; Youssef El Amrani, step 3, 3,655 euros a month. Placements are reviewed each January.
